visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short blonde-dyed hair and glasses is seated at a white table in a bustling indoor cafe. She is wearing a cream-colored collared shirt over a grey turtleneck and holds a pink smartphone with both hands, carefully framing a shot of a Tiramisu slice and an iced latte. The background shows out-of-focus patrons and wooden furniture under warm indoor lighting. (2) As she remains focused on her phone screen, a hand holding a silver fork enters the frame from the right side, poised to take a piece of the dessert. The woman immediately stops her photography, looks directly into the camera lens with a wide-eyed, slightly annoyed expression, her mouth closed and eyes fixed while her hands remain steady on the phone. (3) The fork successfully scoops a portion of the cake while the woman continues to stare at the camera with a playful yet disapproving gaze. She eventually breaks into a subtle, knowing smirk, acknowledging the humor of the situation while still holding her phone in a shooting position above the white tabletop and partially eaten dessert.
